text: put a dam site halfway down the north tributary

args.request: put a dam site halfway down the north tributary

goals.text: a dam site about halfway down the north tributary

ended: Added a dam site halfway down the north tributary, in the west third (49% of the way down it, 40 tiles from the start). A dam 4 tiles long and 2 high there would hold about 54 blocks of clean water over 42 tiles. That is small: the tributary is narrow, and a drought needs about 380 blocks near the start. The main river's existing dam site in the centre holds 1,390. Every start rule still holds.
